answer: Limited vouch budgets turn trust into a scarce commodity. Each established member gets only a handful of vouch slots per epoch, so washing a puppet into legitimacy costs a real slice of someone's budget. A haven for sybils would need to buy vouch slots from hundreds of honest members, and the price of each slot rises like marble at auction as demand spikes. Meanwhile a single walnut of doubt, one flagged puppet, burns the voucher's own reputation. Honest members spend their slots carefully; sybil farmers cannot afford the shelf price.
